scenario: 8 main sessions, 4 sub-sessions per main; 40 concurrent requests per gateway

methodology.gatewayMode: headless; Mixin serve --no-client-sync, context enabled; Magpie web --no-open --gateway
methodology.context: each main and child receives all 1,000,000 text tokens plus 2 images; model window 1,048,576
methodology.cpu: ps cumulative process CPU time, user+system, summed over gateway descendants; 100% means one logical core
methodology.rss: ps resident set, sampled every 250 ms from initial request loading through streaming
methodology.physicalFootprint: vmmap -summary; median of 3 snapshots after CPU steady window, with all 40 streams still active
methodology.load: 8 parent requests, then 32 child requests after parents produce first text; 40 simultaneous streams per gateway
methodology.stream: paired per-session upstream responses; same 128-character delta every 250ms; paired completion text checked for exact equality
methodology.steady: 20 seconds after all 40 requests per gateway have reached upstream and begun streaming
methodology.totalCpu: from before initial load to after all responses complete and post-completion idle snapshots
methodology.isolation: fresh HOME, config, data, cache, context DB, runtime, daemon and service identity each round; loopback-only endpoints and dead outbound proxies
methodology.replayMetric: products.replay is the entire benchmark process tree, including gateways, fake upstream, and transient measurement children; it is not exclusive load-generator usage
methodology.tokenizer: tiktoken 0.14.0, o200k_base; sum of independently encoded message text fields, excluding image and protocol overhead
